title: Routing verdict for one subnational reporting unit

unit_id.description: The admin_unit_id this verdict is about, copied verbatim from the evidence.

verdict.description: match_existing: an existing polity already IS this reporting territory -- INCLUDING a national total filed at admin1 level, because the country is a real territory and its polity already exists, so the data can be routed. create_new: the territory is real and no polity represents it. not_a_territory: the identifier names NO territory at all -- a residual bucket ('Other', 'RESID', 'Not specified'), a commodity or an aggregate of unrelated units. Reserved for identifiers nothing could ever be routed to. insufficient_evidence: the evidence given cannot decide it. THE NATIONAL-TOTAL CASE WAS AMBIGUOUS AND SPLIT 11-2: this field previously listed 'a national total wearing a subnational label' under not_a_territory while match_existing's own wording fit it too, so eleven identical <ISO3>-NATIONAL units matched their national row and two (Guatemala, Panama) were declared not a territory. Both readings were faithful to the text. The test is now whether anything could EVER be routed to the identifier: if yes, it is a territory.

matched_polity_code.description: Required when verdict is match_existing; must be one of the candidate codes in the evidence. Null otherwise.

proposed.description: Required when verdict is create_new. Null otherwise.

end_year.description: EXCLUSIVE, matching every other span in this repository.

container_code.description: The polity this unit sits inside, if the evidence names one. The containment interval is derived by the harness from the container's own eras, not asserted here.

span_basis.description: Why this span and not the data's extent. A span defined by how far an extract happens to run must be re-spanned whenever the extract grows, so the basis must be a fact about the administration.

reasoning.description: Why this verdict follows from the evidence. State what would change it.

evidence_used.description: Which supplied evidence lines the verdict rests on. A verdict citing none is not checkable.

concerns.description: Anything the verdict does NOT settle, for a human to look at.

coverage.description:
How every year of this unit's data is accounted for. The unit's data span is given in the evidence; these segments must TILE it with no gap and no overlap, and the harness checks that arithmetically and hands back any gap.

This field exists because a single verdict code cannot cover a unit whose span outlives one polity. Measured over the first 15 match_existing verdicts, FIVE left part of their data outside the matched polity's span -- AUS-QUEENSLAND has data 1860-2022 and matched QUE-1859-1900, stranding 122 years; PER-NATIONAL has 1900-2023 and matched PER-1942-2025, crossing five national eras. Both shapes belong here: a span crossing several eras of the same territory, and a span that matches an existing polity for part of itself and needs a new one for the rest.

start_year.description: First data year in this segment.

end_year.description: Last data year in this segment, INCLUSIVE -- these are data years, not a polity's exclusive end_year.

disposition.description: matched: an existing polity covers these years and the source OBSERVED the territory then. proposed: a new polity is needed for them (describe it in the top-level `proposed`). back_cast: the source reports these years FOR this territory but is projecting it backwards -- the values are a reconstruction onto a boundary that did not yet exist, so the data routes to the polity while the polity's own span still begins when the territory did. Name that polity in polity_code. unroutable: nothing can carry these years -- say why in basis. WHY back_cast EXISTS. The panel's `method` column is given to you per era, and it separates observation from reconstruction: Spain, Portugal, France, Japan and Australia are blank for 96-100% of rows (direct historical statistics), while Colombia is 74% `interpolated_scaled` and 23% `scaled` and Brazil 49% `fallback_interpolated` -- every subnational value there is an allocation of a national total. COL-CASANARE has data from 1900 and became a department in 1991; its early values are `scaled`. Without this option the only ways to account for such years were to stretch the polity's span back to 1900, which invents administrative history, or to call 7,484 data-years `unroutable`, which abandons them. Neither is true.

polity_code.description: Required when disposition is `matched` (a polity whose own span covers this segment) or `back_cast` (the polity the reconstruction is FOR, whose span may legitimately start later than this segment).

basis.description: Why these years belong to that polity, or why they cannot.
